faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Clear and direct answers to help you get started
faq.a1: Yes, absolutely free! We will never ask for a credit card or a subscription. Our mission is to make cyber security accessible to everyone.
faq.q2: I know nothing about cyber security, is this right for me?
faq.a2: Definitely! The path starts from square one: what cyber security is, common attack types, networking and Linux basics, then web security and cryptography step by step.
faq.q3: How do I get the completion certificate?
faq.a3: Once you complete all lessons and pass their quizzes, a personal certificate with a unique verification code is issued and can be verified on the site.
faq.q4: Do I need a powerful computer or fast internet?
faq.a4: No! The interactive terminal and the lab run in a safe simulation directly inside your browser, with no installation or setup required.
faq.q5: Is the content legal and ethical?
faq.a5: Yes, completely. The content is educational and defensive, following an ethical-hacking approach. We teach you to think like an attacker to defend systems, and never encourage attacking real systems without permission.
